entries.note: `O` and `DO` are `*fp16` and `Delta` is `*fp32` (the host passes the `float16` tensors `o`, `do` and the `float32` tensor `delta`, lines 603–606); `Z`, `H`, `N_CTX` are unannotated integer parameters: the body never reads `Z` or `H` (their class, the constant `1`, `int32`, `int64` or `uint64`, changes nothing), and `N_CTX` is a runtime `int32` (`Inst.ok.ctx_lt`; at `1`, possible only with `BLOCK_M = 1`, the constant `1`, which gives the same model: `model`'s docstring); the constexprs `BLOCK_M`, `HEAD_DIM` are Lean parameters; no parameter has a default; the comment markers `#` are not code

entries.model: let off_m : Tensor [BLOCK_M] I32 := tl.program_id ctx 0 * (IntV.ofNat BLOCK_M : I32) + tl.arange 0 BLOCK_M
entries.note: axis 0 of the grid, an `int32`; `* BLOCK_M`: the constexpr built in `int32`, the tensor's dtype (SEMANTICS.md, Constants), wrapping product; `+ tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)`: the scalar added to every lane of the `int32` block (shape `[BLOCK_M]`, a power of two: `Inst.ok.block_pow2`); no lane wraps on covered instances (`off_m < N_CTX < 2^31`)
axis 1 of the grid `(N_CTX // BLOCK_M, Z * H)`, an `int32`

entries.model: let off_n : Tensor [HEAD_DIM] I32 := tl.arange 0 HEAD_DIM
entries.note: the `int32` block `0, …, HEAD_DIM − 1` (shape `[HEAD_DIM]`, a power of two: `Inst.ok.head_pow2`)

entries.model: let o ← tl.load (O + off_hz * (IntV.ofNat HEAD_DIM : I32) * N_CTX + off_m.col HEAD_DIM * (IntV.ofNat HEAD_DIM : I32) + off_n.row BLOCK_M)
entries.note: evaluated left to right: `(off_hz * HEAD_DIM) * N_CTX` is an `int32` scalar (the constexpr built in `int32`; two wrapping products, which do not wrap on covered instances: `Inst.ok.head_fit`), added to the `*fp16` pointer `O`; `off_m[:, None] * HEAD_DIM` is the `int32` block `[BLOCK_M, 1]` of each lane's `off_m` times the constexpr (built in `int32`; no wrap: `Inst.ok.row_fit`), added to that pointer, giving a `[BLOCK_M, 1]` block of pointers; `+ off_n[None, :]` broadcasts both to `[BLOCK_M, HEAD_DIM]` (SEMANTICS.md, Values: `x[:, None]` and `x[None, :]` add an axis, and the operator broadcasts). The model writes the broadcast on the operands (`.col HEAD_DIM`, `.row BLOCK_M`): lane `(i, k)` of `.col` holds `off_m[i]`, and `*` and the pointer `+` act lane by lane, so broadcasting `off_m[:, None]` before `* HEAD_DIM` and before the first pointer `+` gives the same lanes. Each `+` advances the pointer by that many elements (sign-extended `int32` offsets). No `mask`, no `other`: every lane is enabled; the loaded values are `float16` (the pointer's dtype)

entries.model: let «do» : Tensor [BLOCK_M, HEAD_DIM] F32 ← tl.cvt (← tl.load (DO + off_hz * (IntV.ofNat HEAD_DIM : I32) * N_CTX + off_m.col HEAD_DIM * (IntV.ofNat HEAD_DIM : I32) + off_n.row BLOCK_M))
entries.note: the same pointer arithmetic into `DO` as line 258 (the source writes it again, and it runs again), the unmasked load of `float16` values, then `.to(tl.float32)`: `float16` to `float32` with the default rounding, `tl.cvt` (SEMANTICS.md, Float conversions: one rounding to nearest even, and a widening is exact); `do` is a keyword in Lean, so the name is written `«do»`

entries.model: let delta ← tl.sum1c (← tl.mul (← tl.convert .f16 .f32 o) «do»)
entries.note: `o * do`: a `float16` block times a `float32` block computes in `float32` (`BinOp.typing? .mul (.tensor .f16 true) (.tensor .f32 true)` is `some ⟨.f32, .f32, true⟩`, SEMANTICS.md, Operators and promotion), so `o` is converted (`tl.convert .f16 .f32`, `semantic.cast`), then the IEEE `float32` product `tl.mul`; `tl.sum(…, axis=1)` reduces a product, so its additions may be contracted with it (enable_fp_fusion): `tl.sum1c`, along a tree Triton chooses, with `AddRel` nodes and the launch's fusion flag (SEMANTICS.md, Float `+` and `-`; reductions: a float `tl.sum` does not widen, and the input is already `float32`); not `tl.sum_bcast_mul`: the operands are two `[BLOCK_M, HEAD_DIM]` blocks multiplied lane by lane, not a rank-2 operand expanded along a new last axis times one expanded along a new first axis; `tl.sum` is inlined, so no hint is involved

`off_hz * N_CTX` is a wrapping `int32` scalar product (no wrap: `Inst.ok.head_fit`, as `HEAD_DIM ≥ 1`), added to the `*fp32` pointer, then the `int32` block `off_m` (shape `[BLOCK_M]`); `delta` is already `float32`, the pointer's dtype, so no conversion; no mask: every lane stores, each to its own element (`off_hz · N_CTX + off_m[i]` distinct across lanes)
